# Er Novo en aktiefælde eller skal man bundfiske? Investorer er uenige

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Børsen investor podcast centres on Novo Nordisk after its capital markets day in London, where the share fell 7.7%. Guest Johnny Madsen expects Novo to return to growth through CagriSema and its pill, while guest and former Novo IR head Peter Beckgaard sees little growth ahead and calls the stock fairly valued. Other topics were a new-risk view from Maersk's CEO, doubts about the DSV/Schenker synergy timeline, NKT's earnings boom (both guests are sceptical), Buffett quotes, the weak All-Star portfolio, and a shift towards bonds after a strong market run.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EKTA-B — Elekta | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Peter wants to buy Elekta with all the money. The new CEO has bought SEK 55m of shares and cut SEK 500m of costs; a new US product has launched.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Beckgaard (private investor): the ambitious new Danish CEO cut SEK 500m from the cost base in a short time and has put SEK 55m of his own money into the shares, including SEK 10m recently, which signals insider conviction. The share has performed poorly for a long time, and a new product has launched in the US against Varian. Peter admits he may be wrong.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new US product fails to gain traction against Varian
- if the cost cuts do not lift margins
- if the CEO sells shares or leaves

> *"Samma som sist. Köpa elektra. Jag vill köpa elektra. För alla pengar."*

---

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Johnny would clearly buy after the drop from 1900 to 1200. He expects the synergies to be delivered and buybacks of DKK 20-25bn.

#### Reasoning

Guest Johnny Madsen: the market is focusing on the one negative (the Road division) and ignoring the positives. Guidance has not been cut, so the analyst-meeting news is not material. He expects no reduction in the Schenker synergies, and large buybacks should push the share up. Revenue is up 160% over five years while the share is down 25%, so it looks cheap on forward multiples.

#### Sell Triggers

- if DSV cuts guidance or the synergy target
- if the buyback does not materialise
- if the Road division keeps losing market share

> *"Alltså, om du ska peka på dansen, så vill jag klart köpa den."*

---

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Johnny bought it for the portfolio and sees growth returning via CagriSema and the pill. Peter still holds but calls it fair value and doubts upside.

#### Reasoning

The guests disagree. Johnny sees Novo neither as a value trap nor as fully proven; it must show quarter by quarter from 2027 that CagriSema sells, and the pill is winning share in the US. Peter (former Novo IR head) expects little growth for 5-10 years, falling prices and heavy GLP-1 competition. He calls the shares fair value and doubts they will rise. A previously cited analyst sees P/E 8 and a share price near 200.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the CagriSema launch in 2027 disappoints
- if GLP-1 prices fall faster than volume grows
- if competitors take GLP-1 market share

> *"Och därför så är jag i mycket tvivl om aktien kommer att stiga härifrån."*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — Maersk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Johnny cut it from overweight to neutral. He would normally reduce further into strength, but the CEO's geopolitics thesis keeps him neutral.

#### Reasoning

Guest Johnny Madsen: earnings are driven by external shocks (the Suez route, geopolitics). The CEO argues more flexible production means structural demand for more ships, which would ease overcapacity fears. Johnny partly buys the thesis and holds neutral rather than cutting further.

#### Sell Triggers

- if freight rates normalise and overcapacity materialises
- if geopolitical disruption fades

> *"Vi har varit pent övervägt i en märsk och kört den ned på neutralt här för nylig."*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host Simon is positive: EPS is expected to reach about 80 by 2030 at a P/E of about 20. Both guests pass because of weak historical ROIC and industry-wide capacity additions.

#### Reasoning

Host Simon Kirketerp notes that analysts (Lønstrup, Danske Bank's Saxbeck Larsen) are positive on electrification and AI data-centre demand. Johnny warns that competitors are all adding capacity and that higher fixed costs raise downturn risk. Peter's screen excludes NKT because ROIC stayed below his hurdle rate until recently. The earnings momentum is real but the guests are sceptical.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new industry capacity causes price pressure
- if grid or offshore wind projects are delayed
- if ROIC falls back below the cost of capital

> *"Men man ska bara vara säker på att det inte kommer bump på vägen."*

---

### 🟡 COLO-B — Coloplast | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

In Peter's portfolio. A strong report took the share near 480, but it is back at 420, which he thinks is odd given what the company delivers.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Beckgaard holds Coloplast in the All-Star portfolio. He sees it as a quality business delivering well and thinks the share is undervalued relative to its results.

#### Sell Triggers

- if quarterly results weaken

> *"Den handlar märkligt, tycker jag. Baserat på vad de rent faktiskt levererar."*

---

### 🟡 CHEMM — ChemoMetec | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A fantastic business but an expensive share; Peter says it should have been sold near 700. The Roche collaboration is exciting.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Beckgaard has no doubt about the business quality but calls the valuation expensive after a big move up and partial retreat. The Roche collaboration must deliver.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Roche collaboration fails to deliver
- if the valuation keeps stretching

> *"Men jag tycker till exempel att Chemomatic också är en helt fantastisk förhandling. Det har jag slet ingen tvivl om. Men den aktien är dyr."*

---

### 🟡 BIOG-B — BioGaia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

In Peter's portfolio; no news. He awaits Q3 and the London capital markets day in December.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Beckgaard is keeping the position and waiting for the Q3 report and the December CMD. The share is illiquid between quarters.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report or the CMD disappoints

> *"Bauergeier håller en kapitalmarknadsdag i London i december."*

---

### 🟡 FLS — FLSmidth | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Johnny's firm trimmed the position to rebalance into mortgage bonds.

#### Reasoning

Profit-taking as part of a rebalancing after a strong market run, with proceeds moved into Danish mortgage bonds yielding 3.3%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market rally reverses

> *"Vi har tagit toppen av FL Smith och vi har tagit toppen av Jyske Bank."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Johnny's firm trimmed the position to rebalance into mortgage bonds.

#### Reasoning

Profit-taking as part of a rebalancing after a strong market run, with proceeds moved into Danish mortgage bonds yielding 3.3%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market rally reverses

> *"Vi har tagit toppen av FL Smith och vi har tagit toppen av Jyske Bank."*
